Z7 WHAT THIS DOES NOT GIVE
An ordering is not a clock. Even a passing Z4 would give a static ranking of genes
around a circle, with no period, no rate, no checkpoint and no way to advance the
cell from one phase to the next. Nothing here supplies a cell-cycle simulation.
Three further limits, all structural rather than fixable by more permutations:
1. 153 labelled genes is a thin cycle. Published phase-resolved sets run to
well over a thousand, and the missing S phase is not a sampling accident.
2. coexpr and codep are correlations across CELL LINES and TISSUES, not across
time. Bulk co-expression of cell-cycle genes measures how proliferative a
sample is, which moves every phase together and is exactly the signal that
would erase an order. No layer in this model is phase-resolved.
3. ppi and reg are curated, so they inherit the fame confound Z6 measures.
